name: @estate-grid/client
description: Generated GraphQL documents, OpenAPI SDK, and types for estate-grid clients

scripts.build:schema-deps: npm run build --workspace @estate-grid/logger && npm run build --workspace @estate-grid/db && npm run build --workspace @estate-grid/email && npm run build --workspace @estate-grid/auth
scripts.bootstrap: npm run build:schema-deps && npm run schema:export && npm run openapi:export && npm run generate
scripts.generate: npm run generate:graphql && npm run generate:openapi
scripts.build: npm run bootstrap && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ../../scripts/fix-esm-specifiers.mjs dist
